home.title: Welcome to the game
home.description: Head back to the world of arcades and heavy metal and wipe out those evil posh kids trying to bring us down! Revenge is a dish best served in hell.

story.title: Story:
story.p1: In an ordinary neighbourhood, a young metalhead carries the usual baggage: school, home, people who just don't get him. There's only one place where all of that disappears.
story.p2: His usual bar. Beer, heavy metal and real friends. His second home, a sacred place where nothing hurts and problems don't exist.
story.p3: But one day something changed. His mates aren't the same anymore: they've gone soft, posh and fancy ever since they tried a new beer, 50 cents more expensive, something he just can't afford.
story.p4: A few extra cents that make all the difference to a kid like him, a few that really hurt. Sick of watching them turn into something he hates, he decides to leave alone that night: he needs some air, to shelter his rage in the darkness and the cold of the night. He needs to cool down.
story.p5: Out on the street, a posh guy decides he's an easy, lonely target, "he's just a kid"... He goes looking for trouble and finds it. The fight is over fast: he underestimated him, that kid is a metalhead who fights every single day. With the posh guy on the ground and bleeding, he sees something shining on his shirt: a bottle opener.
story.p6: The only thing able to open those cursed bottles that turn your friends posh. From now on, his mission is just one: open every bottle so they go flat before they reach the metal bars and turn his metalhead friends into posh pricks forever.
